principles.effect: Non-derogable right under any circumstances, including state of emergency or continuing consequences.

principles.topic: Inapplicability of Official Immunities for International Crimes
principles.source: ILC Draft Articles on Responsibility of States / Nuremberg Principles
principles.effect: State officials cannot invoke functional or personal immunities when violating peremptory norms (jus cogens).

principles.topic: State Responsibility for Internationally Wrongful Acts
principles.effect: Obligation to cease wrongful acts, offer non-repetition guarantees, and make full reparation.
